question: Among living patients whose last names begin with "A" and who each have exactly one distinct condition, which eight conditions have the highest number of different active medications prescribed to any single patient, and what are their corresponding codes?
sql:
WITH living_a_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.id as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(p.name) n
  WHERE n.family LIKE 'A%'
    AND (p.deceased.boolean IS NULL OR p.deceased.boolean = FALSE)
),
single_condition_patients AS (
  SELECT 
    lc.patient_id,
    c.code.coding[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].code as condition_code,
    c.code.coding[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].display as condition_display
  FROM living_a_patients lc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c ON c.subject.patientId = lc.patient_id
  GROUP BY lc.patient_id, c.code.coding[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].code, c.code.coding[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].display
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) = 1
),
condition_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    scp.condition_code,
    scp.condition_display,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].code) as total_distinct_meds
  FROM single_condition_patients scp
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr 
    ON mr.subject.patientId = scp.patient_id
    AND mr.status = 'active'
  GROUP BY scp.condition_code, scp.condition_display
)
SELECT condition_display, condition_code, total_distinct_meds
FROM condition_meds
ORDER BY total_distinct_meds DESC
LIMIT 8
